scope: Neon-requested diagnostic after Phase A decision seal. Weights are proposed by a new cold-start convex optimizer.
selection: Use all eight structure pairs in public pair-id order, both public acquisitions, both box slots, exact-vacuum b=0 and nominal Neumann relative width 3.
geometry_and_y: Frozen Phase A exact stored binary64 G,S,B,Y. Restrict to non-vacuum state cells for every compared method.
methods: C exact-known-vacuum, independently optimized shared spatial PSD, signed local QCQP, independent directional diagonal QCQP in exact I and Hadamard source bases (the latter permits non-diagonal source PSD matrices).
optimizer: Cold-start convex Clarabel. All material row weights in the non-vacuum state range independently over w>=0. Signed variants allow all optical equality coefficients independently over R. No inertia-bank seeds or constraints.
verification: Objective value is proposal only. Positive K frames, original stored-array Schur bounds and source transforms strictly verified independently at Arb 192 bits. Known witness same as primary Phase A.
truth_access: All 32 decisions, arrays and replay verdicts saved before reading Phase A truth-containing and generating flags in scoring.
